item.note: for reference to this confessional text, see martin, mandala cosmogony, pp. 58-59. a manuscript exists in the berthold laufer collection of the chicago field museum. this text also exists in more than one tbmc reprint volume. compare also no. 37.25, below. the 'bras bu rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i khrid immediately follows, just as a note on fol. 249v says it should.
